sections.st: Drug Delivery Packaging Manufacturer India — Auto-Injector & Prefilled Syringe Packaging, Cleanroom Class 8
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures drug delivery packaging from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom PETG thermoformed packaging for auto-injectors, prefilled syringes, insulin pens, infusion pump components, inhalers, and drug delivery device packaging. Drug delivery packaging manufacturer from Vapi for pharmaceutical device companies and combination product manufacturers across India and for export.

Drug delivery packaging covers combination products — devices that contain or administer drugs — where the packaging must protect both the device mechanism and the drug product simultaneously. Auto-injector packaging must protect the needle safety mechanism from unintended actuation. Prefilled syringe trays must protect the plunger from movement, the needle from damage, and the syringe barrel from breakage. Insulin pen packaging must protect the dose mechanism from impact that could change the dose setting.

sections.st: Drug Delivery Packaging — Specific Technical Requirements

strips.title: Safety Mechanism Actuation — Auto-Injector Activated in Packaging
strips.desc: Problem: Auto-injector packaging where packaging contact forces partially or fully actuate the safety mechanism — the device safety cover is pre-engaged before patient use, rendering the auto-injector non-functional or unsafe. Solution: Safety mechanism clearance analysis from device technical drawing — packaging cavity provides clearance at all actuation surfaces of the safety mechanism.

strips.title: Plunger Movement in Prefilled Syringe Packaging — Dose Volume Displacement
strips.desc: Problem: Prefilled syringe packaging where pressure on the plunger from packaging contact displaces the plunger — changing the fill volume and dose accuracy. Solution: Plunger back-face clearance cavity — no packaging contact on the plunger stopper back face at any point.

strips.title: Dose Mechanism Protection — Insulin Pen Dose Setting Integrity
strips.desc: Problem: Insulin pen packaging where impact loads on the dose mechanism change the dose setting — the pen delivers a different dose than set. Solution: Dose mechanism clearance analysis — packaging cavity provides clearance at dose dial and mechanism surfaces.
